signals.label: NYC Taxi — freshness breach
signals.description: Raw S3 landing `raw_s3_nyc_taxi_trips` is 6h stale vs a 1h freshness SLA. Downstream Spark clean + dbt daily model are at risk.
signals.assertionDescription: Freshness SLA: raw_s3_nyc_taxi_trips must be modified at least every 1h. Currently 6h stale — the S3 ingestion job has not written since 02:00.
signals.failureReason: Dataset not modified in 6h (SLA 1h). Last success 2h ago. Last evaluated at 08:00 UTC.

signals.label: Showcase eCommerce — schema breakage
signals.description: A column rename on the Snowflake source propagated downstream through Looker → dbt → Spark → S3. Schema assertion fails on the Looker chart.
signals.assertionDescription: Schema field count mismatch: Looker chart `revenue_by_region` expects 6 fields, source now exposes 5.
signals.failureReason: Field `region_name` dropped from upstream Snowflake view.

signals.label: Customer PII — governance refusal
signals.description: A signal on `customer_pii` (tagged PII + Restricted). The guardrail must refuse write-back without explicit approval.
signals.assertionDescription: PII exposure check: a downstream consumer requested unmasked fields.
signals.failureReason: Consumer requested masked PII columns in clear text.
